title: Mantago Bay RV Park & Campground

services.name: Daily Rental
services.desc: Come join the family in Sunset Country! With over 100 seasonal sites (and growing) there is plenty of room for you and your friends. Our new seasonal campsites offer 30 amp service in an approximate 80ft x 80ft lot. Yearly rental rate is $1701.00/year (including tax) with invoices sent out in March due April 15th. Incoming trailers cannot be older than 15 years old. Once trailer is in the campground it is grandfathered in. You’re rental covers six persons admission into campground, additional guests are subjected to $3/day or $5/night

gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Nestled at the mouth of the Manigotagan River we are a private campground that is the destination for all of your outdoor fun needs. Boasting a mile long beach with a view across Lake Winnipeg, we are the ideal location for fishing, boating, swimming and any type of water fun.
